description: This file defines the 'SyncService' class, an Android Service responsible for managing the lifecycle of a SyncAdapter and providing a handle for IPC communication for sync operations.

classes.name: SyncService
classes.description: An Android Service that manages a singleton SyncAdapter instance and provides IPC binder for sync requests.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the SyncAdapter instance in a thread-safe manner when the service is created.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Performs cleanup and logs when the service is destroyed.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns the binder object for IPC to communicate with the SyncAdapter.
